item.title: Daniel Berger keeps lead as enough rain takes the teeth out of Bay Hill
item.description: ORLANDO, Fla. — Daniel Berger stopped making as many birdies even after a rain delay took some of the bite out of Bay Hill on Saturday. He still had a two-shot lead in the Arnold Palmer Invitational when darkness kept the third round from finishing.
